metadata.description: Developer productivity plugins by Acendas — agile project management, spec-driven development, sprint automation, comprehensive Atlassian Cloud integration, and AI-driven Android debugging for Claude Code.

plugins.name: shipyard
plugins.description: Turn your idea into working code — Shipyard runs Claude Code through a spec-driven agile sprint lifecycle: discuss features, plan sprints, build with TDD, review, and ship.

plugins.name: atlassian-suite
plugins.description: Unified Jira Cloud + Confluence Cloud + Bitbucket Cloud + QMetry Test Management integration for Claude Code. Jira (issues, sprints, search, attachments, remote links), Confluence (pages, comments, attachments, backlinks, page properties), Bitbucket (PRs, tasks, source browse + blame, pipelines, deployments, branch restrictions), QMetry (projects, full test-case/cycle/step CRUD, test plans, execution results, execution update with status/comment/assignee + execution-level attachment, requirement traceability), plus a 12-scanner PR review pipeline with adversarial critic and deep-dive investigator. Safe docs->Confluence publishing (confluence_publish_preflight / publish_page / markdown_to_storage / render_mermaid / sync_attachments): renders ```mermaid fences to SVG and attaches them in place via a detected local mermaid CLI or a self-hosted Kroki endpoint (never a third-party service by default, and no bundled Chromium); renders Markdown straight to storage XML rather than through ADF, carries <ac:inline-comment-marker> anchors across a page rewrite, refuses to publish when a reviewer's comment or a diagram would be orphaned, and verifies against Confluence's own dangling-comment list afterwards with a restore-version rollback. Credentials stored in ~/.acendas-atlassian/config.json with atomic-write + rolling backup.

plugins.name: android-debugger
plugins.description: AI-agent-driven Android debugger for Claude Code. Kotlin MCP server attaches to debuggable APKs via adb forward (JDI/JDWP) and loads a C++ JVMTI agent (~250–650 KB per ABI; arm64-v8a + x86_64 + armeabi-v7a) for native-speed mutation + tracing. Exposes 14 workflow skills (ad-attach, ad-catch, ad-trace, ad-walk, ad-bisect-flaky, ad-explain, ad-status, ad-setup, ad-detach, ad-investigate, ad-patch, ad-patch-revert, ad-patch-status, ad-graph) plus the autonomous android-debug-orchestrator agent for end-to-end investigation. v1.8 adds standalone, attach-free static analysis backed by SootUp 2.0.0: static_class_hierarchy / static_call_graph / static_cfg / static_package_graph return agent-facing nodes/edges/truncated/warnings plus ASCII and Mermaid renderings, with BFS depth/node-cap bounds, virtual-dispatch-target capping, and Kotlin-synthetic collapse (companions, lambdas, DefaultImpls, coroutine continuations). The new ad-graph skill resolves class_dirs across Gradle modules and android_api_level, with a confirm-then-write Mermaid-persistence flow — routed as a 'Zeroth check' for pure structural questions ('what implements X', 'call graph of Y', 'class hierarchy of Z') ahead of the Debug-Plan shapes, and available mid-plan as a read-only side-query. v1.7 shipped Debug Plans (LLM-as-author, not LLM-in-the-loop): the orchestrator authors a plan declaring setup breakpoints, on_event handler chains with actions, hypotheses graded matched/contradicted/inconclusive, and a streaming plan_progress event feed; the server runs it deterministically over the JDI event stream with no LLM in the loop, compressing investigations from ~20 LLM round-trips to ~3. New MCP tools: run_debug_plan, pause_plan, abort_plan, validate_plan, list/save/load/delete_plan. New dbg.* FEEL namespace. Hybrid concurrency: read-only inspection passes through during a plan; mutating tools return vm_in_plan. v1.7.1 hardens against eight hang surfaces (tool wall-clock budget, attach socket force-close, plan timeout cap, stuck-watchdog, abort_plan 3-stage force-kill, async launch, wait_for_event clamp, proactive vm_disconnected probe). v1.7.2 adds setup-install diagnostics (resolved_count + deferred_count + deferred_targets) so deferred BPs (armed via ClassPrepareRequest) are no longer confused with failed installs. v1.5 HotSwap; v1.6 JVMTI deepening (native-speed heap walks, line-rate method tracing with arg + return-value capture, class-allowlisted allocation tracing). Line/conditional/hit-count/logpoint/exception/method/field/class-load breakpoints, step over/into/out, frame snapshots, DMN-FEEL expression evaluation (kfeel) with side-effect-refusing grammar, eval_method with mutation refusal, persistent breakpoint+watch state, logcat tail, heap dump, capability probe. Designed for AI agents — every tool surface optimizes for agent legibility. Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows). Read-heavy by design; explain-first, fix-second.
